title: Eh…. Save your money
text: Eh…. Save your money. The sticky on the back fell off almost immediately. There was no replacement sticky and no other way to mount it easily. The top tray sticks to any bar of soap and comes off constantly, and the soap sticks so heavily to the inside that you have to almost rip the dang thing off the wall to get it out. Pretty junky dishes. Don’t waste your money.
